question: Where does the old-mask R2 codec disadvantage appear: one write, codec-only repeated writes, or reference-driven recurrent feedback?
scope: Retrospective TRAIN-only mechanism diagnostic; not new model logits, accuracy, timing, fitting, or causal decomposition of prior TEST KL
single_injection_propagation_dtype: float64 (offline diagnostic); recurrent replay update remains float32
repeat_control: Parallel transformed-group-only repeats use the same affine and decode arithmetic without H32; full physical repeat still includes H32 round trips. Neither is a proposed deployment codec.
signed_error_buckets: Store physical and transformed signed means by value-position modulo32 on common snapshots to expose cancellation
reference: Zero-start reconstructed FP32 within-layer recurrence from already normalized captured Native q/k/v/decay/beta. Not actual Native cache state.
native_fidelity_control: Separate BF16-after-write reconstruction vs saved Native reference_output; CPU backend mismatch remains explicit. Do not silently redefine FP32 reference as Native.
strict_positive_denominator: null with reason if zero; no metric denominator clipping
cross_term: 2<Z_own-S_ref, Q(Z_own)-Z_own>; realized pre-write error, not claimed pure temporal term
roundoff_control: Norm of realized pre-write error minus A_t(previous post-write error)
injection: Physical dequantized original-coordinate Q(Z)-Z, including high-tier rounding
single_injection: At write t, propagate only that error through future32 fixed reference transitions; first scored output t+1; no later injections
zero_grid: For low groups containing zero, absolute decoded nearest representable zero divided by stored scale; includes codec-specific coordinate convention
aggregation: Keep token/head observations; report six document-paired macro comparisons and layers separately. No independent-head significance or population CI.
failure_policy: Record first error and keep partial evidence; do not fill missing rows or silently repair nonfinite values. No TEST/data/profile/mask expansion or source edits after freeze.
